title: Creative Direction 101: Campaigns - talking head with image cutaways behind the head
summary: Vertical talking-head reel: a creator at a desk with a studio mic lists 10 brands and how each shoots campaigns. For every brand, a reference image (or a pair of side-by-side images) appears in the top ~45% of the frame with the brand name in small serif at the top, and the speaker is rotoscoped so his head sits IN FRONT of the images. Short serif captions (1-3 words) sit at mid-chest, with emphasis words in italic or bold. Calm, editorial, magazine-like.
fit_reason: The best 'speaker + proof' format for Andrew: he talks, the screen/example sits above his head as an editorial card, and the restrained serif captions read premium, not TikTok-loud. Swap brand photos for HighLevel/portal screenshots.

palette.mood: muted sage-grey room, editorial, natural light; all colour comes from the cutaway images

typography.display: elegant high-contrast serif (Editorial New / Instrument Serif / Tiempos-like), regular weight with italic and bold variants for emphasis
typography.size_behaviour: small captions ~3.2% frame height (~60 px on 1920) centred; brand label top-centre ~2.8% height; title card 'Creative Direction 101: / Campaigns' with the second line in larger italic; closing question 'What can you do that's new?' large (~5%) two-line serif at top
typography.notes: Emphasis rule: one word per caption chunk gets a style switch, either italic ('geometry', 'decadent', 'movies', 'trailers', 'exist', 'beautiful', 'expensive', 'ridiculous', 'creative direction') or bold ('impossible.', 'seriously.', 'film crew.', 'done.'). Never colour, never box.

text_animation: captions hard-swap per phrase chunk (no slide, no pop), chunk shows 1-3 words
brand label hard-swaps with each new brand
title card on frame 0 then dissolves to first caption by ~2.4 s
final question appears as a static large two-line title
captions: phrase chunks of 1-3 words, white serif, no box, very soft shadow, centred horizontally at ~65% of frame height (over the speaker's chest, just above the mic); chunk length ~0.4-1.0 s following speech exactly (e.g. 'shoots food.' 6.5-7.2 s, 'home, and gardening' 7.3-8.1 s, 'exceptionally' 8.2-9.0 s, 'decadent.' 9.1-9.9 s); emphasis word italic or bold, no highlight colour
motion: speaker roto'd (segmented) and composited in front of the image cards so the head overlaps them
occasional image swap within a brand (two shots per brand)
transitions: hard cut of the image card on each new brand name (~every 3-4 s, matches the scene-cut list)
final section drops cards to plain talking head
graphic_elements: full-width image cards in top 45% (single cut-out product on white, or two images side by side split 50/50 edge-to-edge)
small serif brand label above the card
ui_treatment: none here; the image-card slot above the head is the direct place for screenshots or screen recordings

pacing.hold_time_s: 3-4 s per brand card, 0.4-1 s per caption chunk

sound.music: very low bed or none; voice dominant (-14.9 LUFS)
sound.voiceover: yes, on-camera speaker, calm confident list delivery ('X shoots campaigns like Y.')
sound.sync: image card cuts exactly on each brand name; captions word-synced

signature_moves: speaker head layered in front of reference images (depth sandwich)
serif captions with italic/bold emphasis instead of colour highlights
repeated sentence frame 'X shoots campaigns like ___' with a card swap per item
small serif label naming what the card is

best_segments.what: title card 'Creative Direction 101: Campaigns' then Rhode and Entire Studios cards above head with serif captions
Flamingo Estate: two-image card swap, captions 'shoots food. / home, and gardening / exceptionally / decadent.' with italic emphasis
Jacquemus: 'one beautiful scene ... and then makes ... impossible.' showing italic vs bold emphasis and card swap
cards drop away, plain talking head, closing question as large serif title

recreate.how: Andrew filmed vertical; whisper word timestamps -> group into 1-3 word chunks; segment speaker (SAM2 / object-separation skill or RVM) to get an alpha matte; Remotion/ffmpeg: background plate, image cards top 45%, speaker matte on top, serif caption layer at y=65%, label at top. Emphasis words chosen by script (adjectives/punchlines).
recreate.prompt: Vertical talking-head, calm sage-grey room, reference screenshots in a card across the top half with a small serif label, speaker cut out and layered in front of the card, 1-3 word white serif captions at chest height with one italic or bold emphasis word, hard cuts on each new item.
